messages:
maria: Heads up — CI perf alerted a big tail increase on the 2026-03-17 release. Latency p50 ~ same but p99 jumped ~3x after merge 0xabcdef12. Looks like a compile storm + wrong kernel pick on longer seqs.

sam: Where do you see the compile storm? can you paste the CI log snippet?

maria: Paste from perf-ci (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] Autotune: evaluating kernels for op=attention seq=4096 batch=1
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] AutotunePick: kernel=int8_fused_v3 score=0.87 compile_needed=true
[2026-03-17T09:12:04Z] CompileStart: int8_fused_v3 cid=0x7f2a
[2026-03-17T09:12:10Z] CompileEnd: int8_fused_v3 elapsed=6.2s success=true
[2026-03-17T09:12:10Z] KVCache: invalidated prefix=chat-model-v2 reason=model-variant-swap
```

lee: Hmm int8_fused_v3 was meant for short sequences. autotuner score function seems biased by early heuristics we added in the merge. That kernel compiles slower for long seqs and triggers lots of compile work across nodes.

priya: Also seeing kvcache invalidations in the same window — if model-variant-swap happens on rollout, every node cold-compiles + cache miss. That amplifies the compile storm.

tom: Can we confirm the rollout caused the variant swap? deploy-bot shows the canary rollout at 09:11:45. @infra-bot any throttles hit?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout triggered for release/2026-03-17 by @deploy-batch. Autoscaler throttling: false. Compile-queue-depth spiked to 94 (baseline 4).

sam: Ok plan: 1) pause rollout (block further canaries), 2) bisect autotune score change, 3) enable compile-throttling / queue cap to protect nodes. Who can pause?

maria: I paused further canaries. rollout is paused.

lee: I'll start a bisect on autotune heuristics — suspect commit 0x12f4 in perf/autotune that changed score weighting. Running local replay with seq=1024/2048/4096 to repro.

priya: I'll add a temporary kvcache-preserve flag on canary to avoid variant-swap until we have a fix. Patch: `--kvcache-preserve=true` for canary instances.

tom: For immediate mitigation we should cap concurrent compiles: `SERVICE_COMPILE_CONCURRENCY=8` and fallback to existing kernel (safe_fwd_v1) if compile queue > 6. I'll open the rollout-blocker PR.

sam: If the bisect pins it to score weighting, revert or tweak it to penalize compile_time for large seqs. Add a test to CI: long-seq autotune regression test.

maria: Agree. Owners: lee on bisect + PR, tom on runtime cap + fallback, priya on kvcache flag, sam on CI test + final decision.

lee: Starting bisect now. Will update when I have the guilty commit. ETA ~ 2 hours.

maria: Thanks. Adding incident tag and will follow up in the postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
